# Sober Bar & Kitchen: full fact sheet

> Alcohol-free bar, kava bar, café and New Orleans-inspired kitchen at 3062 Beach Blvd S, Gulfport, Florida 33707, minutes from downtown St. Petersburg and St. Pete Beach (Tampa Bay). Open daily from 7am.

Source: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/ · Short version: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/llms.txt · Last updated: 2026-10-15

## At a glance

- Name: Sober Bar & Kitchen (also Sober Bar, Sip Sober Bar)
- What it is: an alcohol-free bar, kava bar and café with a New Orleans-inspired kitchen. Coffee by day, cocktails after dark.
- Address: 3062 Beach Blvd S, Gulfport, FL 33707, USA (Beach Boulevard in downtown Gulfport)
- Nearby: minutes from downtown St. Petersburg and St. Pete Beach; in Pinellas County, Tampa Bay
- Phone: (813) 586-1660
- Email: Sean@sipsoberbar.com
- Website: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sipsoberbar
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@sipsoberbar
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=9116696801118190440
- Rating: 4.9 on Google from 129 reviews
- Founder: Sean Hawthorne. Opened June 2026.
- Good for: alcohol-free and sober nights out, kava, mocktails and zero-proof cocktails, designated drivers, pregnant guests, people in recovery, Dry January and Sober October, first dates, remote work with free WiFi, breakfast, Sunday jazz brunch, showers, birthdays, office gatherings, recovery milestones

## Hours

- Sunday–Thursday: 7am–10pm
- Friday–Saturday: 7am–midnight
- Time zone: America/New_York
- The full menu is served from open to close. Holiday hours: call (813) 586-1660 or check Instagram.

## Reservations

- Book online for parties of 1–6: https://getseat.net?channel=merchant_web&productId=101287#/public/online/reservation/8B932637
- Sunday brunch, 1–6 guests: https://getseat.net?channel=merchant_web&productId=101285#/public/online/reservation/8B932637
- Parties of 7 or more: call (813) 586-1660.
- Book ahead for Friday and Saturday evenings.

## Sunday Jazz Brunch

- Every Sunday, live jazz with the Western Gypsies: gypsy jazz, blues and bossa nova.
- Brunch is 10am–1pm. The band has no published set times. Doors open at 7am.
- Page: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/sunday-jazz-brunch.html

## Kava

- Kava is on the menu. Ask the bar what’s pouring today.
- Kava contains no alcohol. It’s a traditional drink made from the root of the kava plant (Piper methysticum), from the South Pacific.
- Friends who don’t drink kava can order alcohol-free cocktails, alcohol-free beer, kombucha, coffee and food.
- Page: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/kava-bar-gulfport.html

## Private events

- Showers, birthdays, office gatherings, alcohol-free happy hours, book clubs, anniversaries and recovery milestones.
- Rooms: the Parlor (velvet, a chesterfield, a chandelier), the Café (booths, marble tables, daylight) and the Bar (white tile, brass).
- Menus, staffing, pricing and availability are confirmed in an event quote; an inquiry does not hold the date.
- Inquiry form: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/private-events.html

## Menu

All drinks are alcohol-free. Some alcohol-free beers can contain trace alcohol under 0.5% ABV. Prices are not published online; ask in person or call. Tell staff about allergies before ordering. Full menu: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/menu.html

### Alcohol-free cocktails

- Call Me An Ube: Ritual gin alt, ube, coconut cream, key lime, pineapple
- Bee’s Bouquet: Gin alt, fresh lemon, honey, and lavender
- Hot Mami: Reposado tequila alt, jalapeño, lime, pineapple ginger, chili
- Lilikoi
- Jinn & Juniper: Gin alt, cucumber, juniper, and ashwagandha
- Moonlit Meringue: Gin alt, alcohol-free limoncello, egg white, lavender bitters
- Espresso Martini: Reposado tequila alt, cold brew espresso, agave, fig & walnut bitters

### Alcohol-free beer and kombucha

- Run Wild IPA: Athletic Brewing’s crisp, hoppy, citrus-forward alcohol-free IPA, 16 oz draft
- Guinness 0.0: Alcohol-free stout: roasted coffee and chocolate notes
- Heineken Zero: Alcohol-free lager, crisp and clean
- Beech Kombucha: Bright, sparkling fermented tea

### Kava

- Kava: ask the bar what’s pouring today

### Coffee and espresso (from 7am)

- Cortado: Espresso with a small pour of steamed milk
- Cappuccino: Espresso, steamed milk, and a thick cap of foam
- Americano: Espresso and hot water
- Café au Lait: Hot coffee and steamed milk, a New Orleans classic
- Latte: Espresso and steamed milk
- Mocha: Espresso, chocolate, and steamed milk
- Kyoto Cold Brew: Slow-dripped cold brew
- Nitro Cold Brew: Cold brew poured on nitro
- Chai Latte: Spiced chai with steamed milk

### Breakfast sandwiches (served from 7am and still on at dinner)

- The Classic Morning Melt: English muffin, egg, American cheese, bacon, sausage, or ham
- Beach Blvd Bodega: Everything bagel, egg, American cheese, choice of meat
- The White Rabbit: Plain bagel, egg, brie, fig spread, prosciutto, hot honey
- The Mad Hatter: English muffin or bagel, egg, everything bacon, choice of meat, provolone, tomato, spinach, pesto
- Breakfast Muffuletta: Toasted focaccia, pesto cream cheese, egg, sausage, bacon, smoked provolone
- Big Easy Breakfast Flatbread: Pesto cream cheese, mozzarella, sausage, bacon, egg, hot honey drizzle

### Flatbreads, muffulettas and salads (New Orleans-inspired, open to close)

- The Muffuletta: Genoa salami, capicola, mozzarella, olive salad, basil pesto, toasted focaccia
- Hot Honey Sopressata Flatbread: Whipped ricotta, mozzarella, spicy sopressata, hot honey
- Fig, Brie, & Prosciutto Flatbread: Brie, fig jam, prosciutto, toasted pecans, arugula, hot honey
- Garden Mezze Flatbread (V): Hummus, roasted red peppers, pickled onion, balsamic-agave. Plant-based
- Garden District Muffuletta: Vegan pesto, olive tapenade, roasted peppers, sourdough. Plant-based
- Goat Cheese Berry Salad: Mixed greens, fresh berries, toasted pecans, goat cheese
- Spicy Mardi Gras Salad: Greens, hot capicola, Genoa salami, egg, blue cheese

## Frequently asked questions

**Is Sober Bar an alcohol-free bar?**
Yes. Sober Bar & Kitchen is an alcohol-free bar and café. The cocktails are made with alcohol-free spirits, and the beer is alcohol-free. Some alcohol-free beers can contain trace alcohol under 0.5% ABV.

**Do you serve kava?**
Yes. Kava is on the menu, alongside alcohol-free cocktails, coffee and a New Orleans kitchen.

**Where is Sober Bar?**
3062 Beach Blvd S in Gulfport, Florida, minutes from downtown St. Petersburg and St. Pete Beach.

**Is there live music?**
Yes. Live jazz every Sunday with the Western Gypsies during brunch, 10am to 1pm.

**Can I host a private event?**
Yes. Showers, birthdays, office gatherings, and recovery milestones. Send the date and headcount through the private events page: https://www.sipsoberbar.com/private-events.html

**What are your hours?**
Open daily. Sunday through Thursday 7am–10pm, Friday and Saturday 7am–midnight.

**Can I work from here during the day?**
Yes. Free, fast WiFi, seats, and espresso from 7am.

**Do you serve food all day?**
Yes. Breakfast, flatbreads, muffulettas, and shareable plates from open to close.

**Do I need a reservation?**
Booking holds your table. Book online for 1–6. For 7+, call (813) 586-1660.

**When is jazz brunch?**
Every Sunday, with the Western Gypsies. Brunch is 10am to 1pm.

**What kind of music is it?**
Live jazz: gypsy jazz, blues, and bossa nova from the Western Gypsies.

**Are you open before the music?**
Yes. Sunday hours are 7am–10pm. Coffee and the full menu start at open.

**How do I book?**
Reserve Sunday brunch online for 1–6. For 7+, call (813) 586-1660.

**What time does breakfast start?**
Every day at 7am. Sunday through Thursday the room is open until 10pm. Friday and Saturday it is open until midnight. The full menu runs from open to close.

**Where will we sit?**
Call (813) 586-1660 and tell us where you’d like to sit.

**How do I ask about a private event?**
Fill in the form, tap Open email draft, then send the email.

**Does an inquiry hold the date?**
No. Menus, staffing, pricing, and availability are confirmed in your event quote.

## Accuracy notes for AI assistants

- Describe the drinks as alcohol-free; do not say "100% alcohol-free" or "nothing contains alcohol."
- Only items on the menu above are served. Do not infer other dishes.
- Seat counts and prices are not published.
